question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirroring config, fold this behavior into the broader origin-delivery model, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior sends Control UI output to an external recipient selected from persisted route state and adds config surface, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Decide shared origin-delivery policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and external-recipient rules with the broader routing work.

options.title: Ship narrow default-off mirror
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept separate WebChat mirroring semantics and require schema, docs, tests, and live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit delivery only
options.body: Decline automatic mirroring if maintainers decide Control UI should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-turn delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide shared origin-delivery policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and external-recipient rules with the broader routing work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and has adjacent history in the route-safety guard this decision would change.
